title: Intelligent learning method and system
assignee: Shenzhen Samoye Digital Technology Co ltd

pse.problem: The existing intelligent learning method requires two parties to perform interactive modeling, which is complicated and error-prone.
pse.solution_function: The system integrates federated learning and non-federated learning. It allows both host and guest sides to select datasets for uploading to the modeling platform, establishes at least one federated learning mathematical model, unilaterally establishes non-federated learning mathematical models using own data with target variables, learns using the established models in either federated or non-federated mode, and switches learning modes as needed.
pse.solution_structure: The system comprises a modeling platform where federated and non-federated learning mathematical models are established. It also includes components for data selection, model learning, and mode switching on both the host and guest sides.
pse.solution_implementation: In federated learning mode, offline training and online prediction steps are performed to establish a federated learning mathematical model. In non-federated learning mode, only unilateral modeling is done using own data with target variables. The system switches learning modes based on user selection.
pse.effect: The system improves the operation flow of intelligent learning and increases work efficiency by simplifying the uploading process of federated learning data and reducing errors.
